reviewer.independence_scope: Separate reviewer of the actual edits. Project context, arm labels and earlier fixture gold were visible. This is unblinded AI review, not independent human validation.

scope: All 48 semantic_edit outputs (24 sources × baseline/full) in the specified GPT-OSS snapshot. Edit fidelity is judged against each source text, not against candidate-choice labels.

rubric.faithful: No material semantic change identified in this AI review. Acceptable paraphrases and surface-form changes are not counted as semantic errors. This verdict is not a claim of good prose or human preference.
rubric.needs_review: A plausible meaning shift or new ambiguity exists, but ordinary equivalent reading remains possible. Kept separate from confirmed critical examples.
rubric.critical_semantic_change: A concrete central proposition or relationship differs from the source, with an exact before/after binding. Still an AI reviewer judgment, not human gold.
